items.description:
HYFLOCK ransomware has an encryption weakness that leaves parts of larger files readable, giving affected organizations a limited chance to recover data without paying attackers. In the October 17 build, the malware encrypted only the first 4,096 bytes of larger files examined during testing, leaving content beyond that section accessible. The finding does not mean […]
